title: Weatherford Supports Eni’s Junín 5 Integrated Drilling and Completion Campaign in Venezuela
body_markdown:
HOUSTON, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Weatherford International plc (NASDAQ: WFRD) (“Weatherford” or the “Company”) today announced its support of Eni’s Junín-5 development in Venezuela, providing integrated services and technologies to support the field’s workover and drilling campaign.


Weatherford will provide an integrated portfolio of services and technologies across the well lifecycle, leveraging its established presence in Venezuela and global capabilities to drive efficient execution and differentiated performance.


Girish Saligram, President and Chief Executive Officer of Weatherford, said, “We are excited about the opportunity ahead in Venezuela and proud to support Eni as activity at Junín-5 gets underway. Our established presence in the country, combined with the breadth of our global capabilities, positions Weatherford to play a meaningful role in the re-emergence of this important energy market. We see significant potential ahead and are well positioned to capture opportunities as investment and activity increase.”


Weatherford has a long-standing presence in Venezuela and a proven ability to combine local expertise with global technology and service capabilities. Junín-5 strengthens the Company’s position in the market and represents an important opportunity to participate in Venezuela’s next phase of energy development.
